prompt: Before fixing, he writes down the exact steps that make the crash happen every time.
tells: the exact steps that make the crash happen every time
why: A bug you can trigger on purpose is a bug you can test a fix for. That's reproducing it.
trap: Narrowing comes after you can make it happen.

prompt: She can't fix it yet because she can't make it happen on her own machine.
why: Without reproducing a bug, you can't be sure a fix works.
trap: Environment may be why, but the step is reproducing it.

prompt: Support asks the customer exactly what they clicked before the error.
tells: exactly what they clicked before the error
why: Gathering the steps is how you reproduce the bug.
trap: Their data may matter, but the clue is the steps.

prompt: He writes a test that fails because of the bug before changing any code.
tells: a test that fails because of the bug
why: A failing test reproduces the bug reliably.
trap: It also keeps it fixed later, but first it reproduces.

prompt: It only fails one time in ten, so she runs it 50 times to see the pattern.
why: Making a flaky bug show up reliably is reproducing it.
trap: Values come next; first she needs it to happen.

prompt: The tester records a short video showing the bug happening.
tells: records a short video showing the bug
why: A recording shows how to make the bug happen.
trap: It isn't explaining; it's showing the steps.
